videos.script: STRIDE found fourteen threats on the clinic portal. It did not say which of them the clinics should lose sleep over. {{fourteen}} A forged payment and a reminder text that says too much are both on the list. One costs money. The other costs a patient's privacy. STRIDE treats them alike. {{alike}} PASTA starts somewhere else. Before the drawing, it asks what the business is trying to do, and what it cannot afford to lose. {{business}} Then it looks at the system. Then it takes the attacker's side, in three stages. And it ends where it began, with the business, and a number. {{seven}} Seven stages in all. Today you walk them on the portal, see where they overlap with what you already did, and decide when the extra stages are worth their cost. {{cost}}
